import sys
import math

MOD = 998244353

class FFT:
    maxk = 21
    maxn = (1 << maxk) + 1
    wR = [0.0] * maxn
    wI = [0.0] * maxn
    rR = [0.0] * maxn
    rI = [0.0] * maxn
    aR = [0.0] * maxn
    aI = [0.0] * maxn
    n = 0
    k = 0
    lastk = -1
    dp = [0] * maxn

    @classmethod
    def fft(cls, inv):
        if cls.lastk != cls.k:
            cls.lastk = cls.k
            cls.dp[0] = 0
            g = -1
            for i in range(1, cls.n):
                if (i & (i - 1)) == 0:
                    g += 1
                cls.dp[i] = cls.dp[i ^ (1 << g)] ^ (1 << (cls.k - 1 - g))
            cls.wR[1] = 1.0
            cls.wI[1] = 0.0
            for t in range(cls.k - 1):
                a = math.pi / cls.n * (1 << (cls.k - 1 - t))
                curR = math.cos(a)
                curI = math.sin(a)
                p2 = 1 << t
                p3 = p2 * 2
                for j in range(p2, p3):
                    k = j * 2
                    cls.wR[k] = cls.wR[j]
                    cls.wI[k] = cls.wI[j]
                    cls.wR[k + 1] = cls.wR[j] * curR - cls.wI[j] * curI
                    cls.wI[k + 1] = cls.wR[j] * curI + cls.wI[j] * curR
        for i in range(cls.n):
            d = cls.dp[i]
            if i < d:
                tmp = cls.aR[i]
                cls.aR[i] = cls.aR[d]
                cls.aR[d] = tmp
                tmp = cls.aI[i]
                cls.aI[i] = cls.aI[d]
                cls.aI[d] = tmp
        if inv:
            for i in range(cls.n):
                cls.aI[i] = -cls.aI[i]
        length = 1
        while length < cls.n:
            for i in range(0, cls.n, length):
                wit = length
                for it in range(length):
                    j = i + length
                    tmpR = cls.aR[j] * cls.wR[wit] - cls.aI[j] * cls.wI[wit]
                    tmpI = cls.aR[j] * cls.wI[wit] + cls.aI[j] * cls.wR[wit]
                    wit += 1
                    cls.aR[j] = cls.aR[i] - tmpR
                    cls.aI[j] = cls.aI[i] - tmpI
                    cls.aR[i] += tmpR
                    cls.aI[i] += tmpI
                    i += 1
                    j += 1
            length <<= 1

    @classmethod
    def multiply(cls, a, b):
        na = len(a)
        nb = len(b)
        cls.k = 0
        cls.n = 1
        while cls.n < na + nb - 1:
            cls.n <<= 1
            cls.k += 1
        for i in range(cls.n):
            cls.aR[i] = a[i] if i < na else 0.0
            cls.aI[i] = b[i] if i < nb else 0.0
        cls.fft(False)
        cls.aR[cls.n] = cls.aR[0]
        cls.aI[cls.n] = cls.aI[0]
        q = -1.0 / cls.n / 4.0
        for i in range(cls.n // 2 + 1):
            tmpR = cls.aR[i] * cls.aR[i] - cls.aI[i] * cls.aI[i]
            tmpI = cls.aR[i] * cls.aI[i] * 2.0
            tmpR -= cls.aR[cls.n - i] * cls.aR[cls.n - i] - cls.aI[cls.n - i] * cls.aI[cls.n - i]
            tmpI -= cls.aR[cls.n - i] * cls.aI[cls.n - i] * -2.0
            cls.aR[i] = -tmpI * q
            cls.aI[i] = tmpR * q
            cls.aR[cls.n - i] = cls.aR[i]
            cls.aI[cls.n - i] = -cls.aI[i]
        cls.fft(True)
        n_ans = na + nb - 1
        ans = [0] * n_ans
        for i in range(n_ans):
            ans[i] = round(cls.aR[i]) % MOD
        return ans

    @classmethod
    def multiplyPrecise(cls, a, b):
        k = int(math.sqrt(MOD))
        a1 = [x % k for x in a]
        a2 = [x // k for x in a]
        b1 = [x % k for x in b]
        b2 = [x // k for x in b]
        r11 = cls.multiply(a1, b1)
        r12 = cls.multiply(a1, b2)
        r21 = cls.multiply(a2, b1)
        r22 = cls.multiply(a2, b2)
        res = [0] * len(r11)
        for i in range(len(res)):
            res[i] = (k * k * r22[i] + k * (r12[i] + r21[i]) + r11[i]) % MOD
        return res

def expo(orig, pow):
    if pow == 1:
        return orig
    if pow & 1:
        return FFT.multiplyPrecise(orig, expo(orig, pow - 1))
    tmp = expo(orig, pow >> 1)
    return FFT.multiplyPrecise(tmp, tmp)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    k = int(next(it))
    base = [0] * 10
    for _ in range(k):
        d = int(next(it))
        base[d] = 1
    res = expo(base, n >> 1)
    tot = 0
    for e in res:
        tot = (tot + e * e) % MOD
    print(tot)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
